principle: Keep one high-quality WORLD master family per sound. Derive FISHER_CAPTURE and CASSETTE_PLAYBACK through the future recorder pipeline instead of baking three duplicate libraries unless a specific cinematic exception is approved.

families.world_design: Readable child voice with natural room placement, no cinematic reverb bed baked in.
families.capture_design: Mono, narrower, proximity-sensitive, mild level riding, child-recorder character.
families.playback_design: Capture result plus cassette hiss, transport identity and speaker coloration.
families.acceptance: Onboarding take remains intelligible after Fisher and cassette coloration.
families.reuse_policy: Use dry takes as WORLD masters; do not permanently bake Fisher coloration into source files.

variation_plan: REC has the heaviest press identity
STOP is shorter and more final
PLAY is firm but lighter than REC
releases vary subtly to avoid repetition
families.world_design: Chunky spring-loaded child-recorder mechanics; no digital UI click.
families.capture_design: Device self-noise and button transients may leak slightly into a recording when physically plausible.
families.playback_design: PLAY begins with physical engagement before recorded content; STOP ends mechanically.
families.acceptance: REC, STOP and PLAY can be distinguished by ear without looking at the HUD.
families.reuse_policy: Small curated variation pools; do not randomize pitch aggressively.

families.world_design: Mechanical transport feels slower and heavier than modern electronics.
families.capture_design: A trace of transport/motor noise can contaminate the first/last moments of a recording.
families.playback_design: Transport sound brackets playback and helps establish tape materiality.
families.acceptance: The recorder feels like a physical machine rather than a software state machine.
families.reuse_policy: Motor layers may loop very briefly; engagement transients remain one-shots.

families.world_design: Warm low-level domestic bed with breathing room and no oversized cinematic log explosions.
families.capture_design: Close approach reveals more crackle; Fisher capture compresses peaks and loses some low/high extension.
families.playback_design: Cassette reproduction turns fine crackle into a softer granular memory texture without masking it with hiss.
families.acceptance: Supports silence and warmth; never dominates Ronan or the device mechanics.
families.reuse_policy: Crossfade between long beds and random sparse sweeteners; avoid short obvious loops.

families.world_design: Metal hinge has a recognisable tonal signature that can become an auditory landmark.
families.capture_design: Distance and orientation matter strongly; off-axis capture may be thin but still identifiable.
families.playback_design: The tonal squeak survives cassette bandwidth loss and becomes slightly more ghostly/fragile.
families.acceptance: Player can recognise the gate from sound alone after hearing it a few times.
families.reuse_policy: Do not pitch-shift one squeak into every variation; preserve physical speed differences.

families.world_design: Natural irregular movement with quiet gaps; never a constant storm bed.
families.capture_design: Wind can overload or buff the Fisher microphone slightly at close/exposed angles; this imperfection is desirable in moderation.
families.playback_design: High-frequency leaf detail collapses into soft broadband texture while gust envelopes remain recognisable.
families.acceptance: Wind feels alive and variable; the famous Mother call can cut through without fighting a constant loud bed.
families.reuse_policy: Use long beds or state blending; never tile a short loop.

families.world_design: Audible vintage domestic machine, not modern near-silence; low enough to live under conversation.
families.capture_design: Low-mid drone survives well but becomes narrower and less deep; proximity should make the machine feel discoverable.
families.playback_design: Cassette hiss partly merges with compressor texture, creating a useful ambiguity between machine and medium.
families.acceptance: Player notices the fridge when listening deliberately, not because it dominates the kitchen.
families.reuse_policy: Cycle statefully; do not crossfade randomly in ways that break compressor logic.

families.world_design: Small period-appropriate two-stroke moped, modest residential speed, convincing approach/pass/recede arc.
families.capture_design: Timing is the gameplay: REC started late may catch only the tail; distance and occlusion must matter.
families.playback_design: Cassette preserves the Doppler/motion envelope but loses low-end authority and fine engine detail.
families.acceptance: Suggests a world beyond the property without implying a drivable vehicle system.
families.reuse_policy: Prefer distinct recorded passes; do not mirror/reverse a single pass as fake variation.
